acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were collected in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode, consisting of one MS1 full scan (300–1,650 m/z range) acquired at a resolution of 120,000 at 200 m/z with normalized automatic gain control (AGC) target set to 300 and 78 MS2 scans collected at a resolution of 15,000, an isolation window of 17.3 m/z and window overlap of 1. Cycle time was 3 s. HCD collision energy was set at 30%.
Data dependent mode was set as cycle time (1 s).
